# Face fixtures

Public domain portraits used by `tests/unit/verification-onnx.test.ts`. All are
works of US federal government employees, marked "Public domain" on Wikimedia
Commons. Downloaded as Commons thumbnails (long side <= 1920 px), then resized
or cropped, and re-encoded as JPEG.

| file | person | source page | licence | modification |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ride-portrait-1984.jpg` | Sally Ride | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sally_Ride_(1984).jpg (NASA official portrait, retouched by Coffeeandcrumbs) | Public domain (NASA) | 960 px thumbnail as served by Commons |
| `ride-flight-deck-1983.jpg` | Sally Ride | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:S83-35763.jpg (NASA, STS-7 flight deck, 1983) | Public domain (NASA) | head-and-shoulders crop (840x740) of the 1920 px thumbnail, to keep one face in frame |
| `ride-profile-sts7-1983.jpg` | Sally Ride | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:STS-7_-_Sally_Ride,_first_American_woman_in_space,_during_STS-7_mission_(s07-31-1603).jpg (NASA JSC photo s07-31-1603) | Public domain (NASA) | resized to 960 px wide; head turned about 60 degrees, used for the yaw-sign test |
| `glenn-senate-portrait.jpg` | John Glenn | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:John_Glenn_Low_Res.jpg (official US Senate portrait, US Senate Historical Office) | Public domain (US government work) | 960 px thumbnail as served by Commons |

The two Sally Ride photographs taken years apart are the "same person" pair;
the John Glenn portrait is the "different person".
